description: Clamp a numeric score to the inclusive range zero through one.

files.test_app.py:
from app import clamp_score

def test_clamp_score():
    assert clamp_score(-1) == 0
    assert clamp_score(0.4) == 0.4
    assert clamp_score(2) == 1

proposal.new_content:
def clamp_score(value):
    return max(0, min(1, value))
